title: eludite.browser.input input
description: Act on a tab's page as a person would: `click`, `double_click`, `right_click`, `hover`, `type`, `key`, `scroll`, `drag`, `select` or `focus`, on an element by `ref` (from eludite.browser.read_page or find: it is scrolled into view and the action lands on the center of its first box) or at a point `x`, `y` in CSS pixels of the viewport (the space eludite.browser.screenshot reports). The events are real input (Input.dispatchMouseEvent, dispatchKeyEvent, insertText), so the page's handlers run as they do for a person. After the action it waits `wait_ms` (default 500) to collect console errors and a navigation the action caused (ending early once such a navigation has loaded), and answers the element it landed on (ref, role, name, point), the new page_generation, whether the page navigated, and the console errors emitted meanwhile. A ref from an older page_generation is refused: call read_page again. To fill several fields at once, eludite.browser.form_input is faster. Permission class execute. Next: eludite.browser.read_page or screenshot to see the result, eludite.browser.wait for something the action started.

action.description: `click`, `double_click`, `right_click` and `hover` need a target. `type` inserts `text` into the target (focused first) or the focused element. `key` presses `keys` in the target (focused first) or the focused element. `scroll` turns the mouse wheel by `delta` at the target (default: the viewport's center). `drag` presses at the target, moves to `to` and releases. `select` picks `values` in a `<select>` target. `focus` focuses the target.

ref.description: The element to act on: a ref (`e1`, `e2`, ...) from eludite.browser.read_page or eludite.browser.find in the current page generation. Give `ref` or `x` and `y`, not both.

x.description: A point's horizontal position in CSS pixels of the viewport, with `y`.

y.description: A point's vertical position in CSS pixels of the viewport, with `x`.

text.description: For `type`: the text to insert (Input.insertText, as an IME or a paste would).

per_key.description: For `type`: send each character as its own key events (keydown, keypress, input, keyup) instead of one insertion, for pages that listen to keys. Slower. Default false.

keys.description: For `key`: the keys to press one after another, each a name (`Enter`, `Tab`, `Escape`, `Backspace`, `Delete`, `Insert`, `ArrowUp`, `ArrowDown`, `ArrowLeft`, `ArrowRight`, `Home`, `End`, `PageUp`, `PageDown`, `Space`, `F1` to `F12`) or one character (`a`, `A`, `1`, `/`), with modifiers joined by `+` (`Control+a`, `Shift+Tab`, `Meta+Enter`; `Ctrl`, `Cmd` and `Command` are accepted). One string is one key.

delta.description: For `scroll`: how far, in CSS pixels (default `{"x": 0, "y": 400}`: down).

to.description: For `drag`: where to release, a `ref` or a point `x`, `y` in CSS pixels of the viewport.

ref.description: A ref (`e1`, `e2`, ...) from eludite.browser.read_page or eludite.browser.find in the current page generation.

x.description: Horizontal, in CSS pixels of the viewport.

y.description: Vertical, in CSS pixels of the viewport.

values.description: For `select`: the options to select, each by its value or its label; a single `<select>` takes one.

modifiers.description: Keys held during a mouse action, or added to every key of `key`.

wait_ms.description: How long to wait after the action for console errors and a navigation it caused, in milliseconds (default 500).

tab.description: The tab: its id from eludite.browser.tabs (`t1`, `t2`, ...). Default: the active tab (the one last opened or selected).
